text:
Maria Gomez: Quick ask — for tomorrow's candidate (Sara R.) can we block a 15m post-interview sync? Prefer immediately after the loop so feedback is fresh. Small Conf B is usually ideal but if it's full Zoom 'interview-2' works.
Devon Park: I can take behavioral if Priya's tied up. what time is the interview slot?
Maria Gomez: 11:00–11:45 PT. propose 11:45–12:00 PT for the sync. Zoom link I plan to use: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 — can people-ops reserve that slot as a "debrief" room?
people-ops-bot: Reservation created — Zoom room 'interview-2' 11:45–12:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to [Maria Gomez, Devon Park, Li Wei, Priya Nair].
Li Wei: Quick scoring question — are we using the 0–4 scale now or sticking to 1–5 for this role? checklist doc had both in different places.
Priya Nair: We switched to 0–4 last month. My recommendation: pass threshold = overall >=3 AND no 0 in core competency. we can be flexible for IC2 vs IC3, but flag that in comments.
Devon Park: Good call. For consistency can we put this as a short anchor in the debrief invite: `Score anchors: 0=no evidence, 1=weak, 2=ok, 3=good, 4=strong`
Maria Gomez: please add that. Also going to use a very short debrief script to keep us on time: `debrief: [1] Tech highlights (2m), [2] Behavioral (2m), [3] Concerns (2m), [4] Recommendation (1m)` — pasting into the invite description.
Priya Nair: I'll join remotely. @Devon @Li Wei please try to hop on the invite a couple minutes early so we can start exactly at 11:45.
Devon Park: on it. :thumbsup:
Li Wei: noted — I'll bring quick notes on takehome approach. one question: if candidate didn't finish takehome, do we mark a technical 2 or 1? prefer we discuss on a case-by-case basis during the sync.
Maria Gomez: agreed — we'll discuss case-by-case. If you can flag non-completion in the "concerns" section so hiring manager sees context.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set — 15m before debrief (11:30 PT).
Maria Gomez: thanks all — see you tomorrow.
